The one-sentence device_notes disclosure required for an operative-category deviation is absent: this row's device_notes addresses only the Jer.6.20 setumah, not the genre choice. The boundary placement itself (front seam at the Jer.6.18 addressee shift, back seam at Jer.6.21's fresh koh-amar restart) is not in question.
